title: Simeon's Inheritance
description: The second lot fell to the tribe of Simeon, and their inheritance was within the territory of Judah because Judah's portion was too large. The text lists the cities and villages that fell to Simeon, including Beer-Sheba, Moladah, Ziklag, and Rimmon. [ref:Joshua 19:1-9|Joshua 19:1-9]
